warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.00 + 3.00 + 2.50 (8.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02, S-03, A-03, A-07 and A-08 and all agree. Vector CAD PDF; dimension figures are vector strokes (not in the text layer) and were read off the rendered page.

Section 4 rule 4 (every printed x/y tick is a line): structural ticks 1'''' (1.90, S-01/A-03) and A'''' (1.50, S-01/A-03); roof-plan ticks 1'/3' (1.00 overhang), 1'''/2'' (1.50 rafter lines), A''/C' (main-roof 1.00 overhang), D' (lean-to 1.00 overhang); A' (-1.60, ลานซักล้าง edge, A-03 and A-08); and every 1.000 truss panel point (T2/T3 on x: 1'', 1''''', 2', 2'''; T1 on y: A''', A''''', B', B'').

The truss elevations (T1 on S-03, T2 on S-02, T3 on S-03) print no grid bubbles. Their chains are anchored on the supports: T2/T3 posts are labelled T1 (which runs on grids 1, 2, 3 on the roof plans) and their sub-totals 3.00 | 3.00 | 6.00 match grids 1-2-3; T1's posts are labelled T3 / T2 / อะเส (rows C / B / A on S-02) with sub-totals 3.00 | 3.00 | 6.00. Panel points are symmetric so the drawing direction does not change any position.

A'' (-1.00, main-roof edge) and A' (-1.60, ลานซักล้าง slab edge) are different edges, 0.60 apart — both kept. C' (7.00) is the main-roof edge; the lean-to roof over C-D (S-03) is a separate, lower roof.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-07/A-08 and A-01 notes). Beam tops +0.31/+0.41 come from the S-01 beam marks (legend: (+X.XX) = แจ้งระดับหลังคาน). Room-tag floor levels +0.10 (ลานซักล้าง) and +0.36 (ห้องน้ำ, ระเบียง) have no printed label — id null.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-05 plus A-03 (floor plan) and A-07/A-08 (building sections, the only sheets printing the z chain). A-04 (roof plan), A-05/A-06 (elevations), A-09/A-10, E-01 and SN-01/SN-02 were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. A-08 also prints the roof slope as 7 degrees (an angle, not a length — not recorded as a dimension). S-04/S-05 print only member-internal dimensions (footing plan size and depth, section sizes, slab thickness, step riser/tread, truss depths 0.371/0.843/0.740), which stay on their elements.
